title: Pharmacist-led follow-up for adults starting oral anticancer agents: a rapid review of harms, adherence, and staff time and costs
abstract: Objective: to summarise evidence on pharmacist-led follow-up for adults starting oral anticancer agents, in separate strands for harms and dose intensity, adherence by measurement method, and pharmacist time and costs. Design: rapid review with declared shortcuts (single screening with a 20 percent check, English only, abstract-level appraisal for most reports). Results will be written after the remaining search hits are retrieved.
introduction: Oral anticancer agents move toxicity management and adherence into patients' homes. A funding decision needs evidence that does not blur effects and costs into one number.
methods: Library searches of three databases and agency websites; the first search reported 19 hits and returned 8, and the remainder are retrieved before screening closes. Extraction used one form with a strand field; adherence was tabulated by method; costs were reported as ranges.
results: No synthesis has been done yet. The report will present one table per strand and a list of patient groups the evidence does not cover.
discussion: The discussion will state what the committee can and cannot conclude for each strand and for the patients at highest risk.
limitations: English only; single screening; abstract-level appraisal; incomplete first retrieval.
conclusion: To be written after synthesis; limited to the strands as reported.
reportingChecklist: PRISMA 2020 with declared rapid review shortcuts
summary: Rapid review draft with results left empty until the retrieval gate is resolved.
